prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website homepage direction preview, landscape 1440-by-1000 proportions.
Primary request: Design a complete practical campaign homepage for Julia Adele Callahan using an offensive football playbook as its graphic system. The result is a straight-on browser viewport, not a physical poster or notebook. Make the politics and candidate explicit, with legible website navigation and an obvious reading action.
Structure: a slim white top bar with joinjulia.com on the left and My story / Priorities on the right. The opening is a large deep-blue two-part field: the left two-thirds carries an enormous white athletic condensed Democrats on offense headline, the full candidate name Julia Adele Callahan, the smaller label For Bibb County Democratic Party Chair, and a sharp lime Explore the priorities link-button. The right third carries one purposeful lime route drawing over thin blue football field markings; it is decorative, with no numbers pretending to be data. Below the hero, a white section titled The playbook holds four wide, clearly ruled rows with big 01 through 04 and full issue labels. At the bottom show My story and the two story labels. The route drawing is secondary to the headline.
Palette: committed deep royal blue #103CA6, white #FFFFFF, bright lime #D9F267 reserved for route ink and the main action, navy #102644 for body. Strong athletic grotesk display, clear sans body, generous margins, flat ink, squared controls, no distressed grunge.
Text verbatim: joinjulia.com; My story; Priorities; Democrats on offense; Julia Adele Callahan; For Bibb County Democratic Party Chair; Explore the priorities; The playbook; 01; Jail & public safety reform; 02; Election accessibility; 03; Healthcare; 04; Education; How my business started; My journey into politics.
Constraints: this is a campaign site, not a team website or a gamified app. No invented policy specifics, endorsements, dates, statistics, donations, fictional photography, or testimonials. Do not generate a likeness of Julia. Keep the issue labels complete and readable. No gradients, glows, fake scoreboard, card grid, browser frame, or watermarks. The four numbers provide wayfinding, not priority ranking.
